html: † מְלֶ֫כֶת n.f. queen (form difficult; cf. Ol§ 147 d Köii, 169 n. Gie Je 7:18 BaNB 165, Anm. 2; ZMG xii, 1887, 606);—only cstr. מ׳ הַשָּׁמַיִם Je 7:18 + 4 times Je = queen of the heavens, a goddess; identif. dub.; perhaps = Ištar, Venus, cf. Schrinfr. al.; (> = מְלֶאכֶת (Codd.), cstr. of מְלָאכָה (v. לאך), worship of the heavens (Cast Lex. Syriac), or creative work of the heavens, coll. = צְבָא הַשּׁ׳ host of heaven, Stainfr. (cf. 𝔊); v. SchrCOT Je 7, 18; SBAk 1886, 477 ff.; ZA iii, 1888, 353 ff., iv. 1889, 74 ff. StaZAW 1886, 123 ff. 289 ff. KueGes. Abh. 186 ff. WeSkizzen iii. 38 NöZMG xli. 1889, 710 f. RSSem i. 57, 172 (ed. 2, 57, 189) GrünbZMG xlii. 1888, 45);—only as worshipped by people of Jerusalem לַעֲשׂוֹת כַּוָּנִים לִמְ׳ הַשּׁ׳ Je 7:18 (‖ הַסֵּךְ נְסָכִים לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים); לְקַטֵּר לִמ׳ הַשּׁ׳ Je 44:17, 18, 19, 25 (all ‖ הַסֵּךְ לָהּ נְסָכִים).
